explanation: The offensive's own § Prelude counts the raid on Dioura among what it answered: "The CSP-PSD began a series of raids against Malian and Wagner military bases throughout September; Bourem, Léré, Dioura, Bamba, and Taoussa were all pillaged between September 12 and October 3, and dozens of Malian soldiers were killed." The next sentence is the answer — "In response to the attacks, the Malian junta launched airstrikes on Kidal on October 2" — and October 2 is the day the offensive is dated from. Written forward in time, so the raid is the thing reacted to and the offensive is the reaction. Probable: Wikipedia alone.
